title: Worth it
text: Hector was great! The two sites were stunning. Not sure if this is due to Viator or the operator but the instructions said to to be there 15 min before start time which is fair, but the start time was 15 min before the first site even opened. So that part could be improved.
author: G7501NUstephaniee

title: Really informative tour of two beautiful houses
text: Really enjoyable tour of these two beautiful houses. Hector was so informative and really brought the places to life. I learnt so much about the history of both and also gained a greater understanding of their importance to Seville. Going in the morning was great for avoiding the crowds and having a guide gave me a greater insight into subtle details you would miss if you visited self-guided.

title: Entertaining and pleasant guided tour.
text: It has been an enriching experience. The guide in particular, Héctor, a charming, pleasant, and attentive guy, as well as a huge professional, since he had to conduct the tour in both Spanish and English; I really liked his confidence and ease. You can tell from a mile away that he is passionate about what he does. I hope to run into him again on another guided tour. 😊
